Wer vom iPhone kommt, vermisst oft die T: People coming from the iPhone often miss the keyboard most. LiBoard adopts the proportions, layout and habits of the iPhone keyboard – and keeps everything you type on your phone.
Buchstaben, Zahlen und Zeichen liegen do: Letters, numbers and symbols are where you know them from the iPhone. At the bottom always the same row: 123 · Emoji · space · action.

x² und x₂ in der Vorschlagsleiste: H₂O,: x² and x₂ in the suggestion bar: H₂O, SO₄²⁻, m² – works in every app.

Miss Fehlerquote, Korrekturen und Tempo: Measure error rate, corrections and speed – and compare with your previous keyboard. Everything stays on the phone.
